description: 150 Peewees in one line, 8 px apart, every one with its feet at the same world z, so they all fall in ONE 16-px row of DrawGameScreen's unit sort. That row holds viewW/16 + 12 units (68 at 1024x768), and the line on screen holds more: the engine's append at 0x469807 (the sort-row capacity, exe-reverse-engineering.md 'Engine defects we patch'). At 1x with the line across the view the extra units spill into the next row's slots; with the camera pinned so the line sits in the LAST sort row (tacli eye <i> 1552 650 at 1024x768) and the view widened (zoom 0.5 with vpwide), they spill past the end of the buffer. Read the row counts with tacli peek; nothing fights, nothing moves.
